# Nomado (NOMADO合同会社 / Nomado Ltd)

> Nomado is the company behind Nomad Weddings New Zealand, Nomad Weddings Japan, Property Media Japan, Queenstown Memories and Niseko Memories. It provides destination weddings and elopements, photography and videography, property media and vacation rentals for international clients across Japan and New Zealand. Founded in Queenstown, New Zealand (solo from 2012, incorporated 2018, renamed Nomado Ltd 2023). NOMADO合同会社 was incorporated in Japan on 1 September 2026, with the Japan office in Kobe from October 2026. Founder and Creative Director: James Hirata (https://www.jameshirata.com/).

Site: https://www.nomado.co.jp/ (English and Japanese, toggle in the nav)
Contact: info@nomado.co.jp

## Brands

- Nomad Weddings New Zealand: https://nomad.wedding/ (helicopter weddings and elopements out of Queenstown, since 2012, up to 205 weddings a year)
- Nomad Weddings Japan: https://nomadweddings.jp/ (elopements and small weddings across 11 locations including Kyoto, Tokyo, Kamakura, Mt Fuji, Naoshima, Miyakojima, Niseko, Otaru, Furano; since 2023; Japanese team fluent in English)
- Property Media Japan: real estate photography, video, drone and AI assisted HDR editing for agents selling Japanese property to overseas buyers (contact by email)
- Queenstown Memories: https://queenstownmemories.co.nz/ (travel and family photography in Queenstown and Wanaka)
- Niseko Memories: https://nisekomemories.jp/ (travel and family photography in Niseko)
- Vacation rentals: Queenstown (https://majestichomesqt.holidayfuture.com/listings/564788) and Otaru

## Facts

- Queenstown team of six, Japan team of three with planners in Kyoto, Tokyo, Niseko and Okinawa
- Clients from more than 20 countries
- Press: The Japan Times, NHK News, TV Asahi Hatori Morning Show, Nikkei, Zexy Overseas Wedding
